stem:
Gita pulls up a wheat plant and a chickpea plant. The wheat plant has many thin roots of nearly the same size and no single main root. The chickpea plant has one main root with smaller side roots arising from it.

Which labelling is correct?

options.text: Wheat has a taproot system; chickpea has a fibrous root system.
Wheat has a fibrous root system; chickpea has a taproot system.
Both plants have taproot systems because both have roots in soil.
Both plants have fibrous root systems because both were pulled from soil.

teacher.key_rationale: One main root with side roots is a taproot (chickpea); a bunch of similar thin roots is fibrous (wheat). Swapping those labels reverses the relationship; merely having roots in soil does not decide the type.
